title: create_story
description: Initialise the single active story. Auto-generates a spec-valid IFID when none is supplied (spec-defined default behaviour per FR-014, documented in the guide).

format_version.description: Defaults per format when omitted: Harlowe 3.3.8, SugarCube 2.36.1, Chapbook 2.1.0, Snowman 2.0.2 (at the time of writing). Actual defaults may track upstream — see guide.

ifid.description: Optional; auto-generated by extwee when omitted.

clarification_triggers: format omitted AND client has not configured a default: ask which of Harlowe/SugarCube/Chapbook/Snowman (valid_answers enumerated)
